_readme: Open roles on kli-recruitment.co.za. Edit this file, then run: python3 tools/build_jobs.py  (rebuilds jobs/*.html and the list on job-seekers.html). Jobs appear in this order. sector is 'fin' (Finance) or 'sec' (Secretarial & Reception).

jobs.title: Qualified Accountant
jobs.summary: Take ownership of the day-to-day accounting function and support management with accurate, timely financial information.
jobs.about: A Cape Town-based company is looking for a qualified accountant to strengthen its finance team.
jobs.role: You'll take ownership of the day-to-day accounting function and support management with accurate, timely financial information.
responsibilities: Prepare monthly management accounts and financial statements
Manage the general ledger, bank reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations
Oversee accounts payable and receivable
Prepare and submit VAT, PAYE and other SARS returns
Assist with budgeting, forecasting and cash flow management
Support annual audits and year-end processes
Maintain strong internal controls and improve finance processes
Supervise and guide junior finance staff
requirements: BCom Accounting degree or equivalent
Qualified CA(SA), CIMA, ACCA, or SAIPA/SAICA-registered (or equivalent professional designation)
3+ years' post-qualification experience
Strong knowledge of IFRS and South African tax legislation
Proficiency in Excel and accounting software (e.g. Sage, Xero, SAP or Pastel)
Excellent attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines
Strong communication and problem-solving skills
offer: Competitive salary of R50,000 – R60,000 per month

jobs.title: Articled Clerk – CA(SA) Training Contract
jobs.summary: Start your CA(SA) journey with hands-on training in audit, accounting and tax at a SAICA-accredited firm.
jobs.about: A Cape Town-based accounting and auditing firm. The firm is SAICA-accredited and committed to developing the next generation of chartered accountants.
jobs.role: Start your CA(SA) journey with hands-on training in audit, accounting and tax, supported by experienced mentors and a structured development programme.
responsibilities: Assist with audit and assurance engagements across a variety of clients
Perform testing, vouching and reconciliations
Prepare working papers and support financial statement preparation
Assist with tax and accounting assignments
Liaise with clients and gather information professionally
Meet deadlines while maintaining high quality standards
requirements: BCom Accounting (or equivalent) degree, with CTA/Postgraduate Diploma in Accounting completed or in progress
Passed or on track to write the SAICA Initial Test of Competence (ITC)
Strong academic record
Good knowledge of IFRS and accounting principles
Proficiency in Excel and MS Office
Strong attention to detail, a willingness to learn and the ability to work in a team
Own transport and a valid driver's licence (advantageous)
offer: Competitive monthly salary of R10,000 – R13,000, reviewed annually
Opportunities for permanent employment after qualifying
jobs.applyAs: Articled Clerk – CA(SA) Training Contract (R10,000 – R13,000)

jobs.title: Senior Bookkeeper
jobs.summary: Manage the full bookkeeping cycle through to trial balance, with clean records and timely reporting.
jobs.about: A Cape Town-based company is looking for an experienced senior bookkeeper to keep its finances accurate and up to date.
jobs.role: You'll manage the full bookkeeping cycle through to trial balance, ensuring clean records and timely reporting for management and the accountant.
responsibilities: Capture and process all financial transactions accurately
Manage accounts payable and receivable, including supplier and debtor reconciliations
Perform bank and credit card reconciliations
Process payroll and manage UIF, SDL and PAYE submissions
Prepare and submit VAT returns
Maintain the general ledger and prepare the monthly trial balance
Assist with month-end and year-end closing and audit queries
Guide and review the work of junior bookkeepers or clerks
requirements: Diploma or certificate in Bookkeeping or Financial Accounting (or equivalent)
Minimum 5 years' bookkeeping experience, including full-cycle to trial balance
Strong knowledge of VAT, PAYE and SARS eFiling
Proficiency in Excel and accounting software (e.g. Sage, Xero, Pastel or QuickBooks)
High attention to detail and strong organisational skills
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
offer: Salary of R16,500 – R18,000 per month

jobs.title: Bookkeeper
jobs.summary: Handle the day-to-day bookkeeping, from capturing transactions to reconciliations, supporting the senior team and accountant.
jobs.about: A Cape Town-based company is looking for a reliable bookkeeper to join its finance team and keep its records accurate and up to date.
jobs.role: You'll handle the day-to-day bookkeeping function, from capturing transactions to reconciliations, supporting the senior team and accountant.
responsibilities: Capture and process daily financial transactions accurately
Manage accounts payable and receivable, including supplier and debtor reconciliations
Perform bank reconciliations
Process invoices, payments and petty cash
Assist with payroll, UIF and VAT submissions
Maintain the general ledger and assist with the monthly trial balance
Support month-end and year-end processes
File and maintain accurate financial records
requirements: Diploma or certificate in Bookkeeping or Financial Accounting (or equivalent)
Minimum 2–3 years' bookkeeping experience
Working knowledge of VAT, PAYE and SARS eFiling (advantageous)
Proficiency in Excel and accounting software (e.g. Sage, Xero, Pastel or QuickBooks)
Strong attention to detail and good organisational skills
Ability to meet deadlines and work well in a team
offer: Salary of R12,500 – R15,000 per month

jobs.title: Tax Administrator
jobs.summary: Prepare and submit tax returns and manage SARS eFiling for a well-established Cape Town accounting firm.
jobs.about: A well-established accounting firm in Cape Town is seeking a detail-oriented Tax Administrator to join its team.
jobs.role: This is a great opportunity for someone with a strong understanding of South African tax compliance to grow within a professional accounting environment.
responsibilities: Preparing and submitting tax returns for individuals and companies
Managing SARS correspondence and eFiling
Maintaining accurate client tax records
Assisting with provisional tax and VAT submissions
Liaising with clients and SARS to resolve queries
requirements: A relevant qualification in tax, accounting or finance
At least two years' experience in a similar role
Strong knowledge of SARS eFiling and tax legislation
Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software
offer: Salary of R18,000 – R23,000 per month, depending on experience

jobs.title: Receptionist / Administrator
jobs.summary: Be the friendly first point of contact for clients and visitors, and keep the office running smoothly.
jobs.about: A Cape Town-based company is looking for a friendly, organised receptionist/administrator to be the first point of contact for its clients and visitors.
jobs.role: You'll run the front desk and provide general administrative support, keeping the office running smoothly and professionally.
responsibilities: Greet and assist visitors, clients and suppliers
Answer and direct incoming calls and emails
Manage diaries, bookings and meeting rooms
Handle incoming and outgoing post and courier deliveries
Capture data, prepare documents and maintain filing systems
Order stationery and office supplies
Assist with invoicing, quotes and basic admin tasks
Provide support to management and colleagues as needed
requirements: Matric (Grade 12); administration or office management qualification (advantageous)
Minimum 1–2 years' reception or administration experience
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Professional appearance and friendly telephone manner
Strong organisational and multitasking skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Own transport (advantageous)
offer: Salary of R9,000 – R12,000 per month

jobs.title: Receptionist / Administrator

jobs.role: You'll manage the front desk and provide day-to-day administrative support, helping the office run smoothly and professionally.
responsibilities: Welcome and assist visitors, clients and suppliers
Answer calls and emails, and route them to the right person
Manage diaries, bookings and meeting room schedules
Handle post, couriers and deliveries
Capture data, prepare documents and keep filing up to date
Order stationery and office supplies
Assist with invoicing, quotes and general admin
Support management and colleagues where needed
requirements: Matric (Grade 12); an administration or office management qualification is advantageous
At least 1–2 years' experience in reception or administration
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel and Outlook)
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Professional appearance and a friendly telephone manner
Good organisational and multitasking abilities
Able to work independently and in a team
Own transport is advantageous
offer: Salary of R10,000 – R12,000 per month, based on experience
